wire: ModelCapabilityProfile/v1 -> bounded current-run observation and active-run context budget -> SessionEffectivePolicy/v1
transport: built Electron host:invoke sessionActivity.snapshot -> actual Gateway session.activitySnapshot

receipt.transport: built Electron host:invoke sessionActivity.snapshot -> actual Gateway session.activitySnapshot

fields.backend: configured|effective|unverified plus runtime kind and native compaction ownership
fields.grants: aggregated owner action authorization without grant ids
fields.context: configured token limit plus active-run effective budget only when session, provider/model, and run-start facts match
fields.queue: session queue settings plus owner queued count
fields.resources: configured concurrency/depth limits and explicit effective unverified
fields.schedule: configured cron limits and explicit current-state unverified

negativeCases: a context budget from before the active run remains configured-only
a context budget for another session, provider, or model remains unverified
current context-budget and capability generation mismatches stay unverified
invalid capability observation does not promote runtime/model/grant facts
limitations: The real journey observes configured policy before a model turn; effective runtime backend/model/grants and active-run context promotion are additionally covered by unit owner facts, not claimed from configuration.
